question: When was the National Watershed Development Project for Rainfed Areas (NWDPRA) launched in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1990-91**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The National Watershed Development Project for Rainfed Areas (NWDPRA) was launched in India during **1990-91**.
 
• The project was initiated under the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperation to address critical challenges in **rainfed agriculture**.
